facts.fact: The World Bank's Somalia Digital Economy Diagnostic says the web-based, custom-built financial management systems of the federal government, Puntland and Somaliland (SFMIS, PLFMIS, SLFMIS) have each been 'implemented in all MDAs, state-owned enterprises and municipalities', hosted at regional level with a cloud back-up; it gives no count of municipalities, does not say where municipal staff work in the system or how their offices are connected, and gives no date, so the date here is the document's published year.
facts.system: Municipalities' use of SFMIS, PLFMIS and SLFMIS

facts.fact: The World Bank's Somalia Digital Economy Diagnostic says the web-based financial management systems of the federal government, Puntland and Somaliland are implemented in 'all' municipalities of each, with no number of municipalities working in them and no total given; it is undated in the passage, so the date here is the document's published year.
